purpose: Allows the user to pick one option from a predefined list. Best suited for four or more mutually exclusive choices where showing all options at once would take too much space.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label associated with the select

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when no option is selected

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown below the select

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text shown below the select

props.name: variant
props.description: Validation style. Defaults to error when errorMessage is set, otherwise default

whenToUse: When the user must choose one option from four or more mutually exclusive choices
When screen space is limited and listing all options inline would crowd the layout
Inside a form for fields like country, timezone, or category
whenNotToUse: For fewer than four options — use a radio group instead
For multiple simultaneous selections — use a multi-select or checkbox group
For yes/no decisions — use a Checkbox or Toggle
antiPatterns: Using Select when only two or three options exist
Omitting a label — always provide a visible label

anatomy: Label above, 40px native select with a square SVG chevron, helper or error text below
sizes: Field `size-control-md` (40px), `space-component-padding-field` sides, extra end padding for the chevron
states: Same as Input: `color-border-input`, `color-border-input-hover`, focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`, error `color-border-danger`
The option list is the browser's native menu, so `shadow-component-menu` is reserved for a future custom menu
motion: Border colour over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Must have an associated label element via htmlFor/id pair
Must be keyboard navigable with arrow keys and Enter/Space
Error messages must be linked via aria-describedby
Uses role='combobox' or native <select> — do not use a div without full ARIA implementation
Dropdown list must be announced to screen readers when it opens
